credentialOpencodeCookieInstructions: Sign in at https://opencode.ai/console, open the browser developer tools Network tab, select any request under /console/api/, and copy the full Cookie request header value. The session lasts about 30 days. The value is stored as a Kandev global secret and never shown again.
credentialJunieApiKeyInstructions: Generate a token at https://junie.jetbrains.com/cli. The same token also works as the JUNIE_API_KEY environment variable for the Junie CLI. The value is stored as a Kandev global secret and never shown again.
credentialCardDescription: Add the credential that lets Kandev read this provider's live quota and prepaid balance on the Usage page. Without it, quota-aware routing cannot see this account.
credentialSavedImmediately: Saved immediately. It does not use the page's Save changes button.
